author: Shaneisburning
quote: The game is written by and made for women. This game and the content in it is everything wrong with the modern gaming industry. They don't know what players want, or they don't care, or this is on purpose. Why is it so bad for men to have something that's for them? The first 25% of the game is insufferable. Taking away the horrible story campaign, the game itself is still GTA and there's fun to be had free roaming and interacting with the world. But the story is hot garbage.
